subject: MSA offboarding ops: termination SLA and notice window coordination
messages:
From: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@neurolytics.com>

Cc: Marcus Holt <marcus.holt@neurolytics.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: MSA offboarding and termination mechanics (redline attached)

Hi Mina —

Thanks for the call yesterday. Attached is our legal team's redline to the MSA (we focused Section 2.3, Term and Termination, and the Order Form cancellation mechanics). Two quick asks so we can coordinate with Finance and Procurement on our side: 

1) Confirm Redwood's standard notice window for termination for convenience (we saw 60 days in the draft; please confirm whether that is firm or negotiable).
2) Clarify whether there is a payment-in-lieu or short-notice fee if Neurolytics exercises an early termination inside the notice window.

We'd like to finalize the termination mechanics this week so our legal ops can prepare the PO and Docusign flow. I've attached a clean redline and a short summary.

Attachment: Redwood_MSA_Section_2_3_redline.pdf (pdf, 48KB)

Thanks —
Sophie Lee
Head of Legal Operations
Neurolytics, Inc.
S: +1 415-555-0182
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@neurolytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 12:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA offboarding and termination mechanics (redline attached)

Hi Sophie — thanks for sending the redline and summary. Looping in Karthik (sales) and Laura (legal ops) so we can align on the operational side. Quick responses below and proposed next steps.

Short answers:
- Notice window: Redwood's default for Termination for Convenience is 60 days. We can consider 90 days for enterprise customers as a concession, but that typically triggers a higher termination fee or a phased offboarding schedule.
- Payment-in-lieu: We do support a pro-rated payment-in-lieu option (calculated on remaining committed minimums for the then-current term). We usually only apply that if the customer requires <30 days notice.

Proposed next steps (suggested timeline):
1) Today: Redwood to provide an Order Form redline that aligns termination language with the MSA (I will attach).
2) Tomorrow: Legal ops (Laura) to confirm exact fee schedule for short-notice terminations (30d and 45d thresholds).
3) Wed, Apr 7: Finalize redlines and circulate a combined MSA+Order Form for signature via DocuSign.

If Neurolytics needs a 90-day window without fees, we can present that to revenue for approval but it will change renewal economics. Karthik — can you confirm whether Neurolytics has internal procurement deadlines they need us to hit?

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: OrderForm_v3_redline.docx (docx, 24KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA offboarding and termination mechanics (internal notes)

Mina / Laura — internal notes for negotiation: 

- Neurolytics procurement is on a tight quarter-close schedule; they want signed docs by EOW Apr 9 to align with their fiscal close. If we hold firm to 60d notice, that still works operationally (offboarding starts after signature).
- If they push 90d no-fee, we should ask for either: (a) a ramp-down commitment (50% of committed baseline for the longer notice period) or (b) a time-limited concession (90d only this term).
- Fee schedule proposal: 30d notice = 100% of remaining committed MRR for 30 days; 45d = 50% of remaining committed MRR for 45 days; 60d = no fee. These are negotiable but give us leverage.

Laura — can you draft two short redline options for the Order Form: default (60d, no fee) and concession (90d with ramp or fee). I'll present both to Sophie and Marcus.

-Karthik
From: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@neurolytics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Holt <marcus.holt@neurolytics.com>, legal.ops@neurolytics.com
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA offboarding and termination mechanics (redline attached)

Thanks — we've discussed internally and can accept the 60-day notice if Redwood will commit to a single 30-day acceleration fee alternative (i.e., Neurolytics can elect to pay a one-time fee equal to 30 days of remaining committed MRR instead of internal ramp commitments). That gives our procurement team the flexibility they need while letting Redwood preserve revenue certainty.

I've attached our updated Order Form redline with that proposal flagged in the margin. If you can incorporate Karthik's fee schedule language into the Order Form cleanly, we're prepared to sign as soon as we have the DocuSign envelope.

Attachment: OrderForm_v3_redline.docx (docx, 18KB)

Sophie / Marcus — thanks for the clarity and quick turnaround. Per our thread and internal approvals, summary below and next steps: 

Agreed points:
- Notice window: 60 days (MSA Section 2.3) — agreed.
- Short-notice alternative: Neurolytics may elect to pay a one-time fee equal to 30 days of remaining committed MRR in lieu of a ramp-down commitment (documented in the Order Form).
- Fee schedule: Redwood will include the internal fee matrix (30d / 45d / 60d) in an appendix to the Order Form for transparency.

Next steps (action owners):
1) Laura to produce the combined MSA+OrderForm redline that inserts the 30-day fee alternative and fee matrix (Due: Fri, Apr 9 EOD) — Attachment: combined_redline_for_signature.pdf
2) Mina to send the DocuSign envelope once Laura confirms the combined redline (Target: Mon, Apr 12). HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DL-2027-0289
3) Neurolytics to confirm PO issuance after DocuSign signature (Marcus / Sophie).

I'll mark this as high priority for Legal Ops to meet your quarter-close. If anything changes on timing, please flag immediately.

Mina
